notes: ORRERY: an original, complete interactive spatial instrument modelling a fictional star system, built with HTML and CSS only — no JavaScript, no external assets, no webfonts. Four working views (Instrument, Catalog, Field Notes, Workshop) driven by native radios/checkboxes plus :has(); a pure-CSS orbital train with selectable bodies, orbital-rate presets, a telescope mode, a reversible button-type=reset; CSS-only filtering/sorting in the catalog; :target-anchored notes with native details/summary; three themes; responsive grid/flex; container queries; logical properties; masks, gradients, filters; scroll-driven and entrance motion guarded by @supports; visible focus; keyboard and touch parity; prefers-reduced-motion honoured plus a manual Still control. Honest limits: no sound, no persistence, no computed output (controls reveal prepared states); enhanced transitions/scroll-driven timelines are progressive enhancements; requires a current browser supporting :has() and container queries; orbiting labels are a mouse convenience with an equivalent keyboard dial; fictional system data is internally consistent invention. No known broken controls or dead ends.
